title: Jodi
desc: After receiving a random call from Shalini, Vinod falls in love with her. When his best friend also falls for her, he tries to sabotage Vinod's chances and woo her on his own.

title: Robinhood
desc: A fearless vigilante steals from the corrupt to help the poor, becoming a symbol of justice and rebellion in a system ruled by greed, deceit, and power-hungry elites.

title: Shravani Subramanya
desc: Subramanya, an aspiring singer, comes to Shravani's rescue when she discovers that her boyfriend Sudeep is a notorious criminal.

title: Elumale
desc: A chance encounter near the Tamil Nadu-Karnataka border in 2004 plunges a cab driver and a young woman into a tense night filled with lurking threats.

title: Dakota Express
desc: Owners of a bus, Krishna and Sundar, face numerous problems due to poor conditions. However, their life takes a turn when the daughter of the minister takes refuge in their bus.

title: Stunt Master
desc: Pooja, a college girl, does not believe in love. Her friends put forth a challenge that she should be friends with a man for thirty days without falling in love with him, but things go awry.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Aalappirandhavan
desc: Durai, a theatre artist, gets obsessed with the roles he plays and murders the men who rape and kill Babu's mother. He then tries to end anti-social elements without revealing his identity.

title: Mr. Garagasa
desc: Muniya, a chatterbox, often meets a producer who has several personal problems. However, using ingenious ways, he helps the man get rid of his issues.
